pk.context: 30 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

tell: A diamond-shaped oral PDE4 inhibitor whose exact therapeutic mechanism is not well defined.

clues.text: Absolute bioavailability is about 73%, and food does not alter the extent of absorption. About 68% is bound to plasma proteins, and it is extensively metabolized, mainly by CYP3A4.
Molecular weight 460.5. The drug substance is practically insoluble in water and slightly soluble in alcohol.
Approved under an NDA as 10, 20 and 30 mg tablets. The adult dose is 30 mg twice daily.
No boxed warning; contraindicated in known hypersensitivity to the drug or any of its excipients. Diarrhea and headache are the most commonly reported reactions.
Active psoriatic arthritis, plaque psoriasis in candidates for phototherapy or systemic therapy, and oral ulcers associated with Behçet's disease.
It inhibits phosphodiesterase 4, which is specific for cyclic AMP, so intracellular cAMP rises. The exact mechanism of its therapeutic action is not well defined.
The generic name begins with A and has ten letters.
